features.name: Environment transfers between Entra tenants
features.description: Customers and partners can transfer Business Central environments between different Microsoft Entra tenants through the tenant admin center, enabling consolidation of multiple tenants or transfer of demo environments to prospective customers.
caveats: Can be scheduled up to 14 days in the future
Destination tenant must accept transfer within 8 hours of request
Destination tenant must have paid Business Central license and available environment quota

features.name: Transfer scheduling
features.description: Administrators can schedule environment transfers to run in the future, with scheduling available up to 2 weeks from the current date.

features.name: Pending transfer cancellation
features.description: Source tenant administrators can cancel pending outgoing transfers before they execute by selecting transfers and clicking the cancel transfers button.

features.name: Environment operations page
features.description: The environment operations page in the source tenant admin center displays transfer requests with details including destination tenant ID, status, and expected execution time.

features.name: Transfer audit trail
features.description: Transfer operations are auditable in both the source and destination tenants as well as in environment telemetry.
